agentTool.name: acn_customer_intelligence_engine
agentTool.description: Before calling this tool, speak a brief pacing phrase: 'One moment while I pull up your profile.' Calls M1 CIE silently after auth to profile the customer. Writes next_best_action[], customer_segment, life_stage_signal, open_applications[] to session state. Silent — customer does not see CIE output.
